What is a gluten free diet?

A gluten free diet is an eating plan that excludes foods containing gluten. Gluten is a protein found in wheat, barley, rye and triticale (a cross between wheat and rye). A gluten free diet is essential for managing signs and symptoms of Coeliac disease (also known as celiac disease) and other medical conditions associated with gluten. A gluten free diet is also popular among people who haven't been diagnosed with a gluten related medical condition. The claimed benefits of the diet are improved health, weight loss and increased energy


What is coeliac disease?

Coeliac disease is a condition where your immune system attacks your own tissues when you eat gluten. This damages your gut (small intestine) so you are unable to take in nutrients. Coeliac disease can cause a range of symptoms, including diarrhoea, abdominal pain and bloating. Coeliac disease is caused by an adverse reaction to gluten, which is a dietary protein found in 3 types of cereal:

- wheat
- barley
- rye

Gluten is found in any food that contains those cereals, including:

- pasta
- cakes
- breakfast cereals
- most types of bread
- certain types of sauces
- some ready meals
- In addition, most beers are made from barley.


What causes coeliac disease?

Coeliac disease is an autoimmune condition. This is where the immune system (the body's defence against infection) mistakenly attacks healthy tissue. In coeliac disease, the immune system mistakes substances found inside gluten as a threat to the body and attacks them. This damages the surface of the small bowel (intestines), disrupting the body's ability to take in nutrients from food. It's not entirely clear what causes the immune system to act this way, but a combination of genetics and the environment appear to play a part.

Treating coeliac disease

There's no cure for coeliac disease, but following a gluten free diet should help control symptoms and prevent the long-term complications of the condition. Even if you have mild symptoms, changing your diet is still recommended because continuing to eat gluten can lead to serious complications. This may also be the case if tests show that you have some degree of coeliac disease even if you do not have noticeable symptoms. It's important to ensure that your gluten free diet is healthy and balanced. An increase in the range of available gluten free foods in recent years has made it possible to eat both a healthy and varied gluten-free diet.

Why Farm Fresh 24/7?

Farm Fresh 24/7 is more than just an app. It is a movement that supports the values of hyperlocalization, food sovereignty, choice, impact, and collective sustainability.

Hyperlocalization: Farm Fresh 24/7 helps you discover and buy food products that are grown or made in your own neighborhood or city. This reduces the environmental impact of transportation and packaging and ensures that you get the freshest and most nutritious food possible.

Food sovereignty: Farm Fresh 24/7 empowers you to choose where your food comes from and who produces it. You can learn more about the people behind the products, their farming or making practices, and their stories. You can also support small-scale and independent farmers and makers who care about quality and sustainability.

Choice: Farm Fresh 24/7 gives you access to a wide variety of food products that you may not find in conventional supermarkets or online platforms. You can browse through different categories, search by keywords, or filter by location, price, rating, or availability. You can also follow your favorite sellers and get notified when they have new products or offers.

Impact: Farm Fresh 24/7 enables you to make a positive impact on your health, your local economy, and your environment. By buying from local sellers, you are supporting their livelihoods and helping them grow their businesses. You are also reducing your carbon footprint and contributing to a more resilient and diverse food system.
Collective sustainability: Farm Fresh 24/7 fosters a sense of collective sustainability among users and sellers. You can join and contribute to the movement by sharing your experiences, recommendations, and recipes with other users, and joining local events and workshops hosted by sellers. You can also chat with sellers, ask questions, give feedback, or request custom orders.
How to Use Farm Fresh 24/7?

Using Farm Fresh 24/7 is easy and fun. Here are the steps to get started:

Download the app: You can download the Farm Fresh 24/7 app from the App Store. The app is free and compatible with most devices.
Create an account: You can create an account using your email address, phone number, or social media account. You will need to provide some basic information, such as your name, location, and preferences. You can also upload a profile picture and write a bio if you wish.
Browse and buy: You can start browsing and buying food products from local sellers. You can use the app’s features to find what you are looking for or explore new and exciting products. You can also see the ratings and reviews of other users, and the distance and delivery options of each seller. Farm Fresh 24/7 does not have a cart option, so you can buy directly from each seller.
Pay directly to the seller: Farm Fresh 24/7 does not handle payments. You pay directly to the seller using your preferred method, such as cash, card, or mobile payment. You can also barter items to build meaningful relationships. 
Enjoy your food: You can either pick up your order from the seller’s location, or have it delivered to your doorstep if the seller offers delivery. You can track your order status and delivery progress with the seller's delivery provider. Share your feedback with the seller and other users by comments on sellers' profile.
